children: Irish annual house price inflation eased slightly to 5.5% in July from 5.6% in June, but prices rose by the fastest monthly rate in a year when they picked by 0.8% month-on-month, Central Statistics Office data showed on Wednesday.
Irish house price inflation has been gradually moderating from the most recent year-on-year peak of 10.1% in August 2024.
